title: Song Writer Haven
description:
Indulge in a serene escape at this expansive property. Bask in the tranquil views of Old Hickory Lake, while having easy access to downtown Nashville's vibrant attractions.

From live music to delectable dining and captivating sights, downtown Nashville's allure awaits a short drive away. Whether you seek nightlife excitement or cultural exploration, Nashville has it all.

Embrace the ultimate blend of relaxation and adventure on your upcoming getaway. Book now for an unforgettable experience!

The space
The house features a large deck overlooking the lake, providing the perfect setting for grilling dinner for the family or simply enjoying the stunning scenery. Inside, there's plenty of room to relax and unwind with comfortable furnishings and modern amenities.

The top floor has two bedrooms with a king and a queen. There is also a beautiful sunroom off of the living area with stunning views. 

The bottom level has two bedrooms: two twins + twin/full bunk bed, two doubles. This level also has a pool table and living room space!

Guest access
You have the whole two story house to yourself.

Other things to note
Ask us for referrals for  boat and kayak rentals.
